replies.text: What's going on with the house right now?
How has that been affecting you?
How long has that been going on?
What happens if nothing changes?
Do you have a plan for how to handle this, or do you need help?
How many payments behind are you right now?
What has the lender been saying when they call or send letters?
How much would it take to get caught up, with the late fees on top?
Is the amount you're behind still growing each month?
If you can't get caught up, what has the lender told you happens next?
What date is the auction set for?
What did the notice say you'd have to pay to stop the sale?
Have you been able to reach anyone at the lender or the attorney's office about it?
How long would you have to be out of the house after the sale?
If the house sells at auction, what have you been told you walk away with?
How many years of taxes are owed on the property?
What's the total the county says you owe now, with penalties and interest?
What notices has the county sent you about it?
Has the county set a date for a tax sale?
If the taxes don't get paid, what has the county told you happens to the house?
Which chapter did you file under, and how far along is the case?
What has your attorney said about keeping the house through it?
Are you keeping up with the payments the court set?
What does the trustee want to do with the house?
If the case doesn't go the way you need, what have you been told happens to the house?
Who holds the lien, and what is it for?
What's the payoff on it now, with interest added?
Has the lien holder taken any steps to collect on it?
Has it stopped you from refinancing or borrowing against the house?
If it doesn't get paid off, what have you been told the lien holder can do?
What's the total owed on the house, counting any second loan or line of credit?
What do you think it would sell for as it sits today?
How far apart are those two numbers?
Is the balance going down each month, or barely moving?
If you had to sell tomorrow, how much would you have to bring to closing out of your own pocket?
How far do you live from the house, and how often can you get out to it?
What has it cost you out of your own pocket to hold onto it so far?
Has anyone been living in it or checking on it since it became yours?
Is the insurance still covering it now that it's sitting empty?
How much longer can you keep carrying it before it becomes a problem for you?
Is anyone living in the house right now, or is it sitting empty?
How long has the house been holding up the rest of the settlement?
What is it costing the two of you each month to keep it while this drags on?
Can either of you afford to buy the other one out?
If the house is still not sold six months from now, what does that do to everything else you're trying to finish?
Are there parts of the house that have gotten too much to keep up with?
What repairs or upkeep have had to wait because of it?
Who do you rely on now when something at the house needs doing?
What does it cost you each month to keep a house this size running?
Say you don't sell this year. What's your plan for managing next year?
How far behind is the current tenant on rent right now?
How many times has the tenant called you about a problem in the last month?
What kind of shape has the tenant left the place in?
Have you had to evict anyone, and what did that run you?
How long did the place sit empty the last time a tenant moved out?
When the tenant calls with an emergency, who has to deal with it?
How long has the house been sitting empty?
Has anyone broken in, or has anything been taken or damaged since it's been vacant?
Has the city sent you any notices or fines about the property?
What are you paying each month in taxes, insurance, and utilities on a house no one is using?
Say it sits empty through another winter. Are you guys going to winterize it?
How long was the house on the market before the listing ended?
Did you do any price drops to get more traction?
What were buyers and their agents saying about the house after showings?
Did any offers come in, and what made them fall apart?
Say you list it again and it sits another 6 months. What's the plan after that?
What date do you have to be in the new place by?
Once you move, will you be paying for two places at the same time?
Who looks after this house once you're living somewhere else?
How would you handle a repair or a break-in here from that far away?
Say the house hasn't sold by the time you move. What's the plan after that?
What is the biggest repair the house needs right now?
What have contractors quoted you to fix it?
How long has it been that way, and is it getting worse?
Has it started causing damage to other parts of the house?
Say the repair doesn't get done this year. Will you fix it before selling next year?
